thread:
Ava (ML Eng): Quick sync: planning to onboard the open model 'wren-7b' into the catalog this sprint. Need to lock owners, license clearance, and perf profile. Proposed milestone: canary start 2026-04-10.
Ravi (Curation): I can own the manifest + metadata ingestion. Will add model card and dataset provenance link by EOD tomorrow.
Lena (Legal): I skimmed the license (Wren Permissive v1). Two asks: (1) confirm model weights are redistributable, (2) confirm no ADL clause. Uploading notes: https://redwood.internal/legal/wren-7b
Ava (ML Eng): Thanks Lena. Can you give a thumbs-up/no on redistribution by 12pm PT? If yes we can proceed with artifact hosting.
Tom (Infra): Heads-up: our quantized-runtime has a bug on token-cache when sequence_len > 2048; we need to test wren-7b shapes. Can we get a small checkpoint (float16) to smoke-test? ETA 48hrs.
Ravi (Curation): I have a 1GB fallback checkpoint — will drop it in s3://redwood-models/wren-7b/test-checkpoint.tar.gz and ping here when done.
Ava (ML Eng): Perf ask for ML infra: please run a short perf profile (latency p50/p95 for 512/1024 tokens, and token/sec throughput) on the test checkpoint. Add quantized run if possible.
Tom (Infra): Got it. I'll spin a small canary node and run the job. If quantized path fails, we'll capture logs and fallback to float16 path for canary.
Lena (Legal): Redistribution OK (weights redistributable) — no ADL clause. Small note: include attribution string in model card. :white_check_mark:
Ava (ML Eng): Awesome — legal green. Ravi, once your manifest + checkpoint are up, can you assign canary owner for week-of roll? Need a volunteer for 2-day oncall during canary.
Ravi (Curation): I can rotate with Mei for canary owner. Assigning myself for week-of roll at least.
Tom (Infra): Perf runs scheduled — I'll post results in ~3hrs. Jenkins will create the canary pipeline once results look sane.
jenkins-bot: Pipeline created: catalog-wren7b-canary #42. Status: queued.
Ava (ML Eng): Perfect. Action items: (1) Ravi — manifest + checkpoint (by EOD) (2) Tom — perf run & logs (by +3h) (3) Lena — upload final license note to model card (done) (4) Ava — prepare canary prompts and eval set. Ping here with any blockers. :pray:
Ravi (Curation): On it. If infra flags the quantized bug, we'll still be able to proceed with float16 canary and add quant later.
Tom (Infra): Noted. If quantized fails, open an infra ticket and I'll slot a patch PR. Will update thread with perf CSV and errors.
Ava (ML Eng): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical sync. If nothing else, I'll start the canary checklist after perf results. :)
